Keep Inc.'s 2025 annual report highlights their strategic transformation into an AI-driven fitness platform, indicating broader industry trends toward AI integration in fitness technology. While Keep Inc. primarily operates in the consumer fitness app space rather than B2B gym management software, their AI developments may signal features that could eventually migrate to B2B platforms like TeamBuildr OS.
